name: Dealer
body:
You worked for a dealer in illicit substances, either by selling on the street or helping to organize shipments to other regions, which involved a certain amount of smuggling.

Benefit You gain a +1 trait bonus on Sleight of Hand checks, and Sleight of Hand is always a class skill for you.
